name: altimate-mcp
description: Connects the Altimate MCP and adds skills for Snowflake and Databricks cost, usage, auto-tune, teams, Studio and lineage questions.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Altimate about Snowflake and Databricks cost, usage, auto-tune, teams and lineage.

defaultPrompt: How has our Snowflake bill moved month by month this year?
Which warehouses cost the most last week, and who drove it?
What would break downstream if we dropped this table?
